ios.desc:
PERSONALIZED NEWS
Keep up with the topics that matter most to you.

NOT JUST ARTICLES... MULTI-PERSPECTIVE STORIES
Particle brings you news from many sources and shows multiple perspectives in one place. See the different sides of a story with "Opposite Sides", and understand how a story is being covered with Particle's political spectrum chart.

SUMMARIZED, YOUR WAY
Read the news in summarized bullet points that tell you what you need to know. Choose from different summary styles, like "Explain Like I'm 5", "The 5Ws", or even a different language to help you understand the story in the best way for you. 

DISCOVER RELEVANT PODCASTS 
Particle listens to podcasts to identify key moments, clip them, and place them right inside the stories you're already reading. 

LISTEN TO THE NEWS
Hit "Play" to listen to your personalized feed of news—perfect for your commute or being hands-free!

FOLLOW ANYTHING
Follow people, places, and things to always get news about them right in your feed. Follow journalists and publishers to always see content from them, too. Want it even faster? When something you follow is making news, you can choose to get notified right away.

INTERACTIVE
Need to learn more? Ask a question about any story, and Particle will answer it for you. Browse questions to learn from what others have asked.

DAILY DIGESTS
Get push notifications for your top news every day.

UPGRADE YOUR EXPERIENCE WITH PARTICLE+
Become a premium subscriber for access to even more customization. Premium subscribers get: Custom Summaries, Voice Choice, Private Questions, access to the entire crossword archive, and a variety of App Icons. 

Terms of use: https://particle.news/terms

quotes.text:
Hello HN! Particle News product engineer here.

Keeping up with the news is overwhelming in an age of information overload. Particle reimagines the experience by organizing articles into comprehensive "Stories," offering clear, concise summaries to quickly grasp what matters. Today, we reached the #1 spot in "Newspapers & Magazine" on the iOS App Store—and I thought I'd share a bit of our backstory.

I've been connected to this team for a long time. About 20 years ago, I shared a house with our CTO and co-founder Marcel Molina. I helped him get started with programming. Since then, Marcel has had an extraordinary career—becoming a senior staff engineer at Twitter, where he helped build foundational features like Retweets, Notifications, and Lists, and later working at Tesla on manufacturing execution systems that scaled across Gigafactories.

At Twitter, Marcel worked closely with our CEO and product visionary Sara Beykpour, who led initiatives like Twitter Blue, Twitter Video, and the experimental app twttr. Sara has a background in Software Engineering and Cognitive Science from the University of Waterloo and spent over a decade at Twitter in engineering and leadership roles.

In late 2022, Sara and Marcel started prototyping a news app that could reduce the cognitive and emotional burden of staying informed—by using AI to help people understand more, faster.
